callees.name: write_payload
callees.pre_condition: trace_dir is a writable directory path. event_id is a non-empty string. name is a non-empty string suitable as a filename. content is a string.
callees.post_condition: Atomically writes content to a file under trace_dir keyed by both event_id and name. Returns the relative filesystem path to the written file.

callees.name: record_trace_event
callees.pre_condition: trace_dir is either a writable directory path or a falsy value. event is a dict containing trace event fields including at minimum 'event_id' (non-empty string) and 'timestamp' (ISO 8601 string).
callees.post_condition: When trace_dir is truthy, thread-safely appends the event dict as a single JSON line to the trace events file under trace_dir. When trace_dir is falsy, is a no-op.
